svg.title: Material assignment through a planar transition
svg.desc: Four horizontal XY layers and two vertical XZ sections of the two-cuboid fixture. Blue cells are A and amber cells are B.

g.text: Material assignment through a planar transition
Two cuboids · 1 mm cells · 4 mm transition · phase (0, 0, 0)
XY views read from y = 3 mm at the top to y = −3 mm at the bottom.
XZ views read from z = 5 mm at the top to z = 1 mm at the bottom.
